motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Extending an Offer for the Position of City Manager and Authorizing the Mayor to Negotiate an Employment Agreement.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Extending an Offer for the Position of City Manager and Authorizing the Mayor to Negotiate an Employment Agreement. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Job offer made for city manager
motions.summary: The council voted to offer the city manager job to its chosen candidate and let the mayor work out the pay and terms.
motions.impact: The city manager runs day-to-day operations, so this shapes who answers when you call about a permit or a pothole. Nothing changes for you until a contract is signed.
